description: Maps every P0/P1 release gate to the red/forced-failure fixture that proves it detects its target defect. All redFixture paths must be *.test.mjs (wired into npm test) — a *.red.mjs path means the fix has not landed.

gates.description: MCP tools carry output schema, safety class, root containment, approval model, rate budget, and audit log.
Credentials are not written in plain text to tracked files; audit trail covers all resolution tiers.
Package ships all runtime-loaded data directories; postinstall writes a mutation manifest.
Host adapter settings (VS Code, Copilot) are correct, JSONC-safe, and classified by typed readiness state.
Service manager kills only Construct-owned processes; stale or foreign PIDs are never signalled.
Docker surface is degated per ADR-0039; no Dockerfile or docker-push job is present.
CI/CD pipelines pin action SHAs and restrict job permissions to least privilege.
Web search results and intake packets carry trust:untrusted; front-door agent grant is least privilege.
P0/P1 capabilities with no test or stale lastValidated fail the registry gate (errors, not warnings).
Shipped doc templates render correctly and the publish path applies template spacing and figure fidelity.
